name: work-orchestrator
description: Opinionated orchestration of work through two delegation surfaces: dispatched workers — Codex CLI (GPT-5.6) and Claude subagents — via a task-strategy workflow with model and reasoning-effort routing, fenced write scopes, and independent two-worker verification; and sibling Claude Code sessions via a distribution workflow with session enumeration, mandatory dispatch-message blocks, and explicit stand-down closure. Ships 15 agent definitions that pin model and reasoning effort per checkpoint type, because effort cannot be set at spawn time. Both skills are extendable at five workflow positions and via recognized named configuration values; the plugin ships hooks that deliver a project's per-skill extension files (.claude/extensions/work-orchestrator/) wrapped in a structural envelope. Renamed from subagent-orchestrator
